description: The same settings at a value that does not ask for the feature get no warning, even when the file writes them out.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[defaults]
mode = "deferred"
[placement]
new_files = "most-free"
spread_mode = "prefer"
tags_mode = "prefer"
colocate = "none"
overflow = "allow"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[read]
policy = "oldest"
[balance]
schedule = "never"
equalize = "off"
[integrity]
auto_repair = false
[trash]
link_guard = false
[cache]
enabled = false
[ups]
enabled = false
[notify.plex]
url = ""
[notify.jellyfin]
url = ""
[notify.emby]
url = ""
[alerts]
gotify = ""
smtp = ""
[[disk]]
id = "c1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/c1"
fs = "ext4"
role = "data"
[[rule]]
label = "r"
mode = "manual"
spread_mode = "prefer"
tags_mode = "prefer"
colocate = "none"
overflow = "allow"
